create_feature_extractor: create a KyutaiSpeechToTextFeatureExtractor instance with custom sampling rate and feature size for audio preprocessing
featurize_raw_audio: featurize raw audio numpy arrays or lists into model-ready input_values and padding_mask tensors
chunk_audio_by_length: chunk audio into segments of specified length with configurable overlap for streaming inference
pad_audio_with_silence: pad audio inputs with silence prefix and delay for alignment in speech-to-text processing
validate_audio_input_shape: validate audio input arrays match expected mono or stereo channel configuration and dimensions
